title: ERC-8004 alternative path: a transfer clears the agent wallet
summary: An agent identity is sold. The transfer clears agentWallet, so a payer that reads the wallet gets the zero address until the new owner binds a wallet with a fresh signature.

steps.label: transferFrom(old, new, agentId)
steps.detail: A standard ERC-721 transfer. The registry hook clears agentWallet as part of the transfer.

steps.label: getAgentWallet(agentId)
steps.detail: A client that looks up where to pay now gets the zero address. Feedback history stays attached to the agentId, which now belongs to someone else.

failures.condition: The payer cached the old wallet
failures.outcome: It may pay the previous owner; ERC-8004 cannot stop a payment it does not carry.

steps.label: Sign AgentWalletSet
steps.detail: The new owner proves control of a payment wallet with a fresh EIP-712 or ERC-1271 signature.

steps.label: setAgentWallet(...)
steps.detail: The wallet is set again and MetadataSet is emitted. The new owner should also update agentURI and the file.
